title: Mesh Market Bag
description: A lightweight open bag that builds confidence with chain spaces and repeat sections.
expectationText: A practical project with visible progress, where simple mesh repeats quickly turn into something usable.

steps.title: Start the base
steps.instruction: Crochet a short oval or rectangle base and place a marker at the start of each round.

steps.title: Build the mesh
steps.instruction: Work chain spaces and anchor stitches evenly around to create an open fabric.

steps.title: Add height
steps.instruction: Continue the mesh repeat until the bag body reaches a comfortable everyday size.

steps.title: Shape the handles
steps.instruction: Skip sections for the handle openings, then bridge them with long chains on the next round.

steps.title: Reinforce the top
steps.instruction: Work one or two solid rounds around the opening and handles so the bag feels sturdier.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Fasten off, weave in the ends, and stretch the bag lightly with your hands so the mesh opens evenly.
